info.title: Relay Partner API
info.description:
REST API for Relay Partner agencies. Authenticate with a live key (`relay_pk_live_…`). Use API sandbox keys (rb_sbx_, relay_pk_sbx_) on the sandbox server to test. Rate limits: 120 requests/minute per API key and 300/minute per client IP; over the limit you get 429 with a Retry-After header. Webhooks are documented here for payload shape only — configure the URL on the Developer page.

**Shop keys (E-commerce, "Connecter mon site")**: an approved Relay shop owner creates `rb_live_<48 hex>` (production) keys on Partners → Connecter mon site (shown once, stored hashed, max 3 active, revocable). Same headers and envelope. Shop keys may call GET /me, GET /pricing/estimate, GET/POST /packages, GET/PATCH /packages/{tracking_code}, GET /packages/{tracking_code}/status and PATCH /packages/{tracking_code}/cancel; agency-only routes answer 403 SHOP_KEY_NOT_ALLOWED. Sending through the API is free (you pay the normal delivery price, minimum fee applies). Caps: 60 estimates/min per key; 20 packages/day for new shops (first 30 days or until 20 delivered) then 200/day (DAILY_LIMIT, Retry-After 3600); 30 packages waiting for a driver at once (PENDING_LIMIT). Shop webhooks: see `x-webhooks.shopPackage`.

post.description:
Create a package for this agency. `own_fleet` does not require GPS. `platform_open` and `hybrid` require pickup and delivery coordinates; the server persists the grid fee (GET /pricing/estimate first). Send `Idempotency-Key` and/or `external_order_id` to make creates safe to retry.

**Credits**: where the agency's country charges at creation, the package's credits (1 on fixed pricing, or the per-km estimate) are taken when it is created and the later driver assignment is free; not enough credits → 402 `INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS` and nothing is created. Cancelling within 15 minutes of creation (window set per country) and before pickup refunds that charge in full; after that it is kept.

**Shop keys**: send a `ShopCreatePackage` body. `platform_order_id` is required and idempotent (same id again → same package, `idempotent: true`, HTTP 200). Pass the `quote_id` from GET /pricing/estimate to keep the quoted price (same shop, not expired, unused, same points within 200 m). `"test": true` validates and prices without creating anything (HTTP 200). 201 when created.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Key chosen by the client. Retrying with the same key returns the original package instead of creating a second one.

get.summary: Estimate delivery fee for a route
get.description:
Evaluates the agency pricing grid from pickup and delivery coordinates (always required). Optional `distance_km` only replaces the measured distance used for the platform minimum when assignment_mode is platform_open or hybrid.

**Shop keys**: returns a `ShopEstimate` with a `quote_id` (≈15 min) to pass to POST /packages. Same price as the Relay app for that trip (grid + time pricing + campaign discount), never under the minimum fee. Pickup defaults to the shop's saved pickup point. No delivery GPS → `price_type: "from"` (lowest possible price; the final price is fixed at create). 60 estimates/min per key.

parameters.name: pickup_lat
parameters.description: Agency keys: required. Shop keys: optional (default: the shop's saved pickup point).

parameters.name: pickup_lng
parameters.description: Agency keys: required. Shop keys: optional (default: the shop's saved pickup point).

parameters.name: delivery_lat
parameters.description: Agency keys: required. Shop keys: optional (without it price_type is "from").

parameters.name: delivery_lng
parameters.description: Agency keys: required. Shop keys: optional (without it price_type is "from").

parameters.name: delivery_address
parameters.description: Shop keys only, when delivery_lat/lng are not sent: the customer's address text. Relay finds the point (in the shop's country, near the pickup) and prices it; the answer adds geocoded (true/false) and geocoded_address. Nothing found: the "from" price as without coordinates.

parameters.name: delivery_type
parameters.description: Shop keys only. Express is not available yet: 'express' is accepted and answered as standard with delivery_type_note.

example.error: pickup_lat, pickup_lng, delivery_lat and delivery_lng are required.

apiKey.name: X-API-Key
apiKey.description: Same keys as bearerAuth (relay_pk_… or rb_…).

code.description: Stable code for programmatic handling (UNAUTHORIZED, VALIDATION_ERROR, PRICING_UNAVAILABLE, NOT_FOUND, …). Shop keys: INVALID_API_KEY, INVALID_KEY_FORMAT (401); SHOP_NOT_APPROVED, SHOP_INACTIVE, SHOP_PAUSED, SHOP_KEY_NOT_ALLOWED (403); VALIDATION_ERROR, INVALID_PHONE, INVALID_BODY, QUOTE_INVALID, ROUTE_COUNTRY_UNKNOWN and other country-gate codes (400); NOT_FOUND (404); QUOTE_EXPIRED, QUOTE_USED, QUOTE_MISMATCH, CANNOT_EDIT, CANNOT_CANCEL (409); PRICING_UNAVAILABLE (422); DAILY_LIMIT, PENDING_LIMIT, RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED (429); INTERNAL_ERROR (500); API_DISABLED (503).

price_type.description: `from` when no delivery GPS was sent: lowest possible price, the final price is fixed at create.

geocoded.description: Present when delivery_address was sent: true when a point was found.

geocoded_address.description: Present when delivery_address was sent: the place found.

platform_order_id.description: Your order id. Idempotent: the same id returns the same package (idempotent: true, HTTP 200).

delivery_latitude.description: Send both delivery coordinates or neither.

pickup_address.description: Default: the shop's saved pickup point.

delivery_type.description: Express is not available yet: 'express' is accepted and answered as standard with delivery_type_note.

delivery_payer.description: recipient = the customer pays the driver on delivery. Default: saved setting.

delivery_fee_fcfa.description: Can only raise the computed price, never lower it.

quote_id.description: From GET /pricing/estimate. Honoured if same shop, not expired, unused, and same pickup/delivery points within 200 m.

test.description: true = full validation + price, nothing created, no driver, not counted.

ShopUpdatePackage.description: PATCH /packages/{tracking_code} body (shop keys). Every field optional; allowed until pickup.

ShopPackage.description: Package object returned to shop keys.

tracking_url.description: POST /packages and GET /packages/{tracking} only: public tracking page the customer can open (no login). Absent in test mode and in lists.

code_retrait.description: Pickup code (give it to the driver at pickup).

code_livraison.description: Delivery code (the customer gives it to the driver).

ShopWebhookEvent.description: POST body Relay sends to a shop's webhook URL. Headers: X-Relay-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of "<t>.<raw body>" with the whsec_ secret>, X-Relay-Event, User-Agent: Relay-Webhook/1.0.

id.description: Unique per event: dedupe on it.

data.description: ShopPackage without code_retrait / code_livraison / QR codes, plus previous_status.

WebhookEvent.description: POST body Relay sends to your webhook URL. Not an HTTP path on this API.

package.description: The package row at the time of the event (id, tracking_code, status, client and address fields, fees, timestamps, ...).

post.description: Set an https URL and generate a signing secret (whsec_…, shown once) on Partners → Connecter mon site. Verify: HMAC-SHA256 over `${t}.${rawBody}`, constant-time compare with v1, reject if |now − t| > 300 s, dedupe on `id`. Answer 2xx within 5 s; redirects are not followed; retries after 30 s, 5 min, 30 min (4 attempts).

Relay POSTs a signed JSON body to the URL you configure. Header: X-Relay-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex>. Signed message is `{t}.{rawBody}`. HMAC-SHA256 with your signing secret. Reject if |now − t| > 300s.
